source.text: וּבִשְׁנַת֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־נְבָ֑ט מָלַ֥ךְ אֲבִיָּ֖ם עַל־יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And in [the] year eighteen of the king Jeroboam son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.

en.L: And in [the] eighteenth year of King Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijam reigned over Judah.
en.B: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijam became king over Judah.
en.R: Abijam became king of Judah. It was the eighteenth year that Jeroboam son of Nebat had been king of Israel.

es.L: Y en el año dieciocho del rey Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, Abiam comenzó a reinar sobre Judá.
es.B: En el año dieciocho del rey Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, Abiam comenzó a reinar sobre Judá.
es.R: Abiam llegó a ser rey de Judá. Era el año dieciocho del reinado de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat en Israel.

fr.L: Et en la dix-huitième année du roi Jéroboam fils de Nebath, Abiyam régna sur Juda.
fr.B: La dix-huitième année du règne de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, Abiyam devint roi de Juda.
fr.R: Abiyam est devenu roi de Juda. C’était la dix-huitième année du règne de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, sur Israël.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa mfalme Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, Abiyamu akatawala juu ya Yuda.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa mfalme Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, Abiyamu alianza kutawala juu ya Yuda.
sw.R: Abiyamu alianza kutawala kama mfalme wa Yuda. Ulikuwa mwaka wa kumi na nane tangu Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati alipoanza kutawala Israeli.

vi.L: Vào năm thứ mười tám đời vua Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, A-bi-giam trị vì trên Giu-đa.
vi.B: Năm thứ mười tám đời vua Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, A-bi-giam lên làm vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: A-bi-giam lên làm vua Giu-đa. Lúc ấy là năm thứ mười tám Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 느밧의 아들 여로보암 왕 제18년에 아비얌이 유다 위에 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 느밧의 아들 여로보암 왕이 다스린 지 18년째 되는 해에 아비얌이 유다의 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 아비얌이 유다의 왕이 되었다. 그때는 느밧의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘의 왕이 된 지 18년째 되는 해였다.

pt.L: E no décimo oitavo ano do rei Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, Abiam reinou sobre Judá.
pt.B: No décimo oitavo ano do rei Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, Abiam começou a reinar sobre Judá.
pt.R: Abiam se tornou rei de Judá. Foi no décimo oitavo ano em que Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, era rei de Israel.

am.L: በናባጥም ልጅ በንጉሡ በኢዮርብዓም በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት አብያ በይሁዳ ላይ ነገሠ።
am.B: በናባጥ ልጅ በንጉሡ በኢዮርብዓም በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት አብያ በይሁዳ ላይ ነገሠ።
am.R: አብያ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሆነ። ይህም የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም በእስራኤል ላይ በነገሠ በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት ነበረ።

hi.L: और नबात के पुत्र राजा यारोबाम के अठारहवें वर्ष में अबिय्याम यहूदा पर राज्य करने लगा।
hi.B: नबात के पुत्र राजा यारोबाम के अठारहवें वर्ष में अबिय्याम यहूदा का राजा बना।
hi.R: अबिय्याम यहूदा का राजा बना। यह इस्राएल पर नबात के पुत्र यारोबाम के राज्य का अठारहवाँ वर्ष था।

ru.L: А в восемнадцатый год царя Иеровоама, сына Навата, воцарился Авиям над Иудой.
ru.B: В восемнадцатый год царя Иеровоама, сына Навата, Авиям воцарился над Иудой.
ru.R: Авиям стал царём Иуды. Это было на восемнадцатом году царствования Иеровоама, сына Навата, над Израилем.

ja.L: そしてネバトの子ヤロブアム王の第十八年に、アビヤムがユダの上に王となった。
ja.B: ネバトの子ヤロブアム王の治世第十八年に、アビヤムがユダの王となった。
ja.R: アビヤムがユダの王になりました。それは、ネバトの息子ヤロブアムがイスラエルの王になって十八年目のことでした。

uk.L: А у вісімнадцятому році царя Єровоама, сина Невата, зацарював Авіям над Юдеєю.
uk.B: У вісімнадцятому році царя Єровоама, сина Невата, Авіям став царем над Юдеєю.
uk.R: Авіям став царем Юдеї. Це був вісімнадцятий рік, як Єровоам, син Невата, царював над Ізраїлем.

decisions.choice: dated by the reign of the king in the other kingdom
decisions.reason: From here on, Kings dates the start of each reign by the year of the king ruling in the other kingdom, Israel or Judah. This is the first time it does so. The formula then gives the length of the reign, the king's mother (for Judah) and a verdict on the king (verses 2-3, 9-11, 25-26, 33-34).

decisions.choice: reigned: began to reign, became king
decisions.reason: The verb means "to be king" or "to become king". With a date it marks the start of the reign, as in the accession formula of 14:21.

decisions.choice: Abijam: the same king 2 Chronicles 13:1-2 calls Abijah
decisions.reason: Kings calls him Abijam throughout (verses 1, 7, 8), and Chronicles calls him Abijah (2 Chronicles 13:1-23). Abijah means "my father is Yahweh"; Abijam may be another form of the name, or a different spelling of it that came about in copying. Some ancient copies and translations have a form closer to Abijah here. The record keeps Abijam, the form this book uses.

decisions.choice: two sentences, the date second
decisions.reason: Readable splits the formula into two sentences, as these books allow, and names Israel so the reader knows which kingdom Jeroboam ruled.

decisions.choice: "En el año N de X ... comenzó a reinar"
decisions.reason: The dating by the other kingdom's king follows the accession formula of the Kings and Chronicles note for Spanish.

decisions.choice: "En la Ne année de X" (L); "La Ne année du règne de X" (B); two sentences at R
decisions.reason: The dating formula as the Kings and Chronicles terms note words it, one wording per level for every reign.

decisions.choice: akatawala (Literal); alianza kutawala (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Accession is "alianza kutawala" (began to reign) at Balanced and Readable, as the terms note's formula sets; Literal keeps the bare "akatawala".

decisions.choice: "Năm thứ N đời X ..., Y lên làm vua Giu-đa"
decisions.reason: The terms note's dating formula, a king's accession set by the year of the king in the other kingdom; used for every king in Kings.

decisions.choice: "X 왕 제N년에" (L), "X 왕이 다스린 지 N년째 되는 해에" (B), "X가 왕이 된 지 N년째 되는 해" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's accession formula, used for the kings of both kingdoms when one is dated by the other; it is held through the block.

decisions.choice: E no Nº ano do rei X ... Y reinou sobre Judá (L); No Nº ano do rei X ... Y começou a reinar sobre Judá (B); Y se tornou rei de Judá ... no Nº ano em que X era rei de Israel (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the synchronism that dates each reign by the other kingdom's king (m1) keeps one wording at each level, the year as an ordinal ("décimo oitavo"), with "começou a reinar" at Balanced, as the accession formula (14:21), and "se tornou rei" at Readable. "Jeroboão, filho de Nebate" is the form kept with the refrain on his sins.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of 1 Kings 15
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (verses 5 and 29).

decisions.choice: "በ(ንጉሡ) በX በN-ኛው ዓመት Y በይሁዳ / በእስራኤል ላይ ነገሠ" (Literal, Balanced); Readable "Y ... ንጉሥ ሆነ። ይህም X ... በነገሠ በN-ኛው ዓመት ነበረ"
decisions.reason: The date by the other kingdom's king opens every reign from here on (15:9, 25, 33; 16:8, 15, 23, 29); one wording at each level, added to the formulas of the terms list.

decisions.choice: "X के Nवें वर्ष में Y ... पर राज्य करने लगा" (L); "... राजा बना" (B); R splits, the date second
decisions.reason: The accession formula of the history-books note, dated by the king of the other kingdom (meaning m1); Balanced smooths it, Readable splits it as the English does. The same form for every accession in this passage.

decisions.choice: "В N-й год X ... воцарился Y над Иудой" (L, B); "Y стал царём Иуды" (R)
decisions.reason: The accession formula of the history terms note, dated by the king of the other kingdom (m1); Readable splits it, as the English does. The same at 15:9, 15:25, 15:33; 16:8, 16:15, 16:23, 16:29.

decisions.choice: "Авиям"
decisions.reason: As 14:31: kept apart from Jeroboam's son Abijah, "Авия".

decisions.choice: Synchronism "Xの(治世)第N年に、YがZの王となった" (L, B), "…王になって N年目" (R)
decisions.reason: Each new reign is dated by the year of the king in the other kingdom; kept the same through 15-16. Nebat "ネバト".

decisions.choice: The accession formula of the terms note: «У N-му році X, царя ..., зацарював Y» (L), "став царем" (B), and R splits the sentence; names of the kings as "Авіям", "Аса", "Бааша", "Надав", "Йосафат", "Бен-Гадад"
decisions.reason: One wording for every accession through Kings, so the synchronisms between the two kingdoms read alike.

source.text: שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת־אֲבִישָׁלֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: Three years he reigned in Jerusalem, and [the] name of his mother [was] Maacah daughter of Abishalom.

en.L: Three years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother [was] Maacah daughter of Abishalom.
en.B: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Maacah daughter of Abishalom.
en.R: He ruled in Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom.

es.L: Tres años reinó en Jerusalén, y el nombre de su madre [era] Maaca hija de Abisalom.
es.B: Reinó tres años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Maaca hija de Abisalom.
es.R: Gobernó en Jerusalén durante tres años. Su madre era Maaca, la hija de Abisalom.

fr.L: Il régna trois ans à Jérusalem, et le nom de sa mère [était] Maaka fille d’Abishalom.
fr.B: Il régna trois ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Maaka, fille d’Abishalom.
fr.R: Il a régné à Jérusalem pendant trois ans. Sa mère s’appelait Maaka ; c’était la fille d’Abishalom.

sw.L: Miaka mitatu alitawala katika Yerusalemu, na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Maaka binti Abishalomu.
sw.B: Alitawala miaka mitatu huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Maaka binti Abishalomu.
sw.R: Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka mitatu. Mama yake aliitwa Maaka, binti Abishalomu.

vi.L: Ông trị vì ba năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, và tên mẹ ông [là] Ma-a-ca con gái A-bi-sa-lôm.
vi.B: Vua trị vì ba năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Ma-a-ca, con gái A-bi-sa-lôm.
vi.R: Vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem ba năm. Mẹ vua là Ma-a-ca, con gái A-bi-sa-lôm.

ko.L: 그는 예루살렘에서 3년 동안 다스렸고, 그의 어머니의 이름은 아비살롬의 딸 마아가였다.
ko.B: 그는 예루살렘에서 3년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 아비살롬의 딸 마아가였다.
ko.R: 그는 예루살렘에서 3년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 아비살롬의 딸 마아가였다.

pt.L: Três anos reinou em Jerusalém, e o nome da sua mãe [era] Maaca, filha de Absalão.
pt.B: Ele reinou três anos em Jerusalém. A sua mãe se chamava Maaca, filha de Absalão.
pt.R: Ele governou em Jerusalém durante três anos. A mãe dele era Maaca, filha de Absalão.

am.L: በኢየሩሳሌምም ሦስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ የእናቱም ስም የአቢሴሎም ልጅ መዓካ ነበረ።
am.B: በኢየሩሳሌም ሦስት ዓመት ነገሠ። የእናቱም ስም የአቢሴሎም ልጅ መዓካ ነበረ።
am.R: በኢየሩሳሌምም ሦስት ዓመት ገዛ። የእናቱም ስም የአቢሴሎም ልጅ መዓካ ነበረ።

hi.L: उसने यरूशलेम में तीन वर्ष राज्य किया; उसकी माता का नाम माका था, जो अबीशालोम की पुत्री थी।
hi.B: उसने यरूशलेम में तीन वर्ष राज्य किया। उसकी माता का नाम माका था, जो अबीशालोम की पुत्री थी।
hi.R: उसने यरूशलेम में तीन वर्ष तक राज्य किया। उसकी माता का नाम माका था, जो अबीशालोम की बेटी थी।

ru.L: Три года он царствовал в Иерусалиме; имя его матери — Мааха, дочь Авессалома.
ru.B: Три года он царствовал в Иерусалиме. Имя его матери — Мааха, дочь Авессалома.
ru.R: Он правил в Иерусалиме три года. Его мать звали Мааха, она была дочерью Авессалома.

ja.L: 三年、彼はエルサレムで治めた。彼の母の名はアビシャロムの娘マアカであった。
ja.B: 彼はエルサレムで三年間治めた。母の名はマアカといい、アビシャロムの娘であった。
ja.R: アビヤムはエルサレムで三年間治めました。母はアビシャロムの娘マアカでした。

uk.L: Три роки він царював у Єрусалимі; а імʼя його матері — Мааха, дочка Авішалома.
uk.B: Він царював у Єрусалимі три роки. Імʼя його матері — Мааха, дочка Авішалома.
uk.R: Він правив у Єрусалимі три роки. Його мати була Мааха, дочка Авішалома.

decisions.choice: three years: counted in part-years
decisions.reason: Abijam began in Jeroboam's eighteenth year (verse 1) and Asa in his twentieth (verse 9). Kings counts a part of a year as a year, so the reign may have been little more than two full years.

decisions.choice: his mother's name: the queen mother named in the formula
decisions.reason: For the kings of Judah the formula names the king's mother (14:21), because the queen mother held a position of her own at court (verse 13).

decisions.choice: Maacah daughter of Abishalom: probably Absalom son of David; "daughter" may mean granddaughter
decisions.reason: Abishalom is a fuller form of Absalom, and 2 Chronicles 11:20-22 says Rehoboam married Maacah daughter of Absalom and made her son Abijah his heir. 2 Chronicles 13:2 instead names Abijah's mother "Micaiah daughter of Uriel of Gibeah". Since Absalom's only daughter we know of was Tamar (2 Samuel 14:27), Maacah may have been his granddaughter, as "daughter" can mean a female descendant. The text says "daughter", and every level keeps it.

decisions.choice: He reigned three years; He ruled ... for three years
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable start with the subject, as English does; Literal keeps the Hebrew order, which puts the number first.

decisions.choice: "Maaca hija de Abisalom"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew spells the father Abishalom here; Spanish keeps that spelling, as the English does, though he is probably David's son Absalón (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "Maaka fille d’Abishalom"
decisions.reason: Maaka as in 2 Samuel 3:3 (Maaka daughter of Talmai); Abishalom is kept as written, apart from Absalom (m3).

decisions.choice: "Ma-a-ca con gái A-bi-sa-lôm"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew spells the name Abishalom here, so the spelling is kept apart from "Áp-sa-lôm"; the meaning decision explains that he is probably David's son.

decisions.choice: Maaca, filha de Absalão
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also verses 10, 13): the Hebrew "Abishalom" is a fuller form of the name of David's son (m3), so Portuguese writes the form readers know, "Absalão", as 2 Samuel 3:3 does; "Maaca" as there. "Filha" may mean granddaughter, which the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: "የአቢሴሎም ልጅ መዓካ" (Maacah daughter of Abishalom)
decisions.reason: Maacah as David's wife of that name in the Amharic 2 Samuel 3:3. The Hebrew spells the father Abishalom here, not Absalom, so the Amharic keeps "አቢሴሎም" rather than "አቤሴሎም"; the meaning decision says he is probably Absalom.

decisions.choice: "माका"; "अबीशालोम"
decisions.reason: Maacah as 2 Samuel 3:3 in this translation. Abishalom is transcribed as the Hebrew spells it here, kept apart from "अबशालोम" though probably the same man (meaning m3); a reviewer may prefer "अबशालोम".

decisions.choice: "Мааха, дочь Авессалома"
decisions.reason: Maacah as 2 Samuel 3:3 in Russian. The Hebrew spells the father "Abishalom", which most take to be Absalom son of David (m3); Russian uses the traditional "Авессалом", as the Synodal does, rather than a second form a reader would not connect with him.

decisions.choice: Maacah daughter of Abishalom "アビシャロムの娘マアカ"
decisions.reason: Abishalom is kept as the Hebrew spells it (not アブサロム), as the English does; it is probably David's son Absalom, and "daughter" may mean granddaughter.

source.text: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּכָל־חַטֹּ֥אות אָבִ֖יו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֣ה לְפָנָ֑יו וְלֹא־הָיָ֨ה לְבָב֤וֹ שָׁלֵם֙ עִם־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו כִּלְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he walked in all [the] sins of his father which he had done before him, and not was his heart whole with Yahweh his God like [the] heart of David his father.

en.L: And he walked in all the sins of his father that he had done before him, and his heart was not whole with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, like the heart of David his father.
en.B: He walked in all the sins his father had committed before him, and his heart was not wholly given to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, as the heart of his ancestor David had been.
en.R: He committed all the same sins his father had committed before him. He was not completely loyal to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, as his ancestor David had been.

es.L: Y anduvo en todos los pecados de su padre que este había cometido antes de él, y su corazón no fue íntegro para con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios, como el corazón de David su padre.
es.B: Anduvo en todos los pecados que su padre había cometido antes de él, y su corazón no estuvo entregado por completo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios, como lo había estado el corazón de su antepasado David.
es.R: Cometió los mismos pecados que su padre había cometido antes de él. No fue completamente leal {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios, como lo había sido su antepasado David.

fr.L: Et il marcha dans tous les péchés que son père avait commis avant lui, et son cœur ne fut pas entier avec {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu, comme le cœur de David son père.
fr.B: Il suivit tous les péchés que son père avait commis avant lui, et son cœur ne fut pas entièrement à {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu, comme l’avait été le cœur de David son ancêtre.
fr.R: Il a commis les mêmes péchés que son père avant lui. Il n’a pas été entièrement fidèle {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} son Dieu, comme l’avait été son ancêtre David.

sw.L: Akaenda katika dhambi zote za baba yake alizozitenda kabla yake, wala moyo wake haukuwa mkamilifu pamoja na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, kama moyo wa Daudi baba yake.
sw.B: Alifuata dhambi zote ambazo baba yake alikuwa amezitenda kabla yake, wala moyo wake haukujitoa kikamilifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, kama moyo wa Daudi babu yake ulivyokuwa.
sw.R: Alitenda dhambi zile zile ambazo baba yake alikuwa amezitenda kabla yake. Hakuwa mwaminifu kabisa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, kama babu yake Daudi alivyokuwa.

vi.L: Ông đi trong mọi tội lỗi của cha mình đã phạm trước ông, và lòng ông không trọn vẹn với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời mình như lòng Đa-vít cha ông.
vi.B: Vua đi theo mọi tội lỗi cha mình đã phạm trước vua, và lòng vua không trọn vẹn với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời mình như lòng Đa-vít, tổ tiên vua.
vi.R: Vua phạm đúng những tội mà cha mình đã phạm trước kia. Vua không hết lòng trung thành với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời mình như Đa-vít, tổ tiên vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그의 아버지가 그보다 앞서 행한 모든 죄 가운데서 걸었고, 그의 마음이 그의 아버지 다윗의 마음처럼 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 함께 온전하지 않았다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 아버지가 이전에 지은 모든 죄를 그대로 따라 살았다. 그의 마음은 그의 조상 다윗의 마음과 달리, 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 온전히 바쳐지지 않았다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 아버지가 지은 죄를 그대로 다 지었다. 그는 그의 조상 다윗과 달리, 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 온전히 충성하지 않았다.

pt.L: E ele andou em todos os pecados do seu pai que este tinha cometido antes dele, e o seu coração não foi íntegro para com {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, como o coração de Davi, seu pai.
pt.B: Ele andou em todos os pecados que o seu pai tinha cometido antes dele, e o seu coração não foi inteiramente dedicado {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, como tinha sido o coração do seu antepassado Davi.
pt.R: Ele cometeu os mesmos pecados que o pai dele tinha cometido antes dele. Ele não foi totalmente fiel {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, como o seu antepassado Davi tinha sido.

am.L: እርሱም አባቱ ከእርሱ በፊት ባደረገው ኃጢአት ሁሉ ሄደ፤ ልቡም እንደ አባቱ እንደ ዳዊት ልብ ከአምላኩ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ጋር ፍጹም አልነበረም።
am.B: እርሱም አባቱ ከእርሱ በፊት በሠራው ኃጢአት ሁሉ ሄደ፤ ልቡም እንደ ቅድመ አያቱ እንደ ዳዊት ልብ ለአምላኩ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ፈጽሞ የተሰጠ አልነበረም።
am.R: አባቱ ከእርሱ በፊት የሠራውን ኃጢአት ሁሉ እርሱም ሠራ። እንደ ቅድመ አያቱ እንደ ዳዊት ለአምላኩ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ፍጹም ታማኝ አልነበረም።

hi.L: और वह अपने पिता के उन सब पापों में चलता रहा जो उसने उससे पहले किए थे, और उसका मन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के साथ पूरा न था, जैसा उसके पिता दाऊद का मन था।
hi.B: वह उन सब पापों में चलता रहा जो उसके पिता ने उससे पहले किए थे। उसका मन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के प्रति पूरी तरह समर्पित न था, जैसा उसके पूर्वज दाऊद का मन था।
hi.R: उसने वही सब पाप किए जो उसके पिता ने उससे पहले किए थे। वह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के प्रति पूरी तरह वफ़ादार न रहा, जैसा उसका पूर्वज दाऊद रहा था।

ru.L: И ходил он во всех грехах своего отца, которые тот делал до него, и сердце его не было всецело с {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, его Богом, как сердце Давида, его отца.
ru.B: Он ходил во всех грехах, которые совершал до него его отец, и его сердце не было всецело предано {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, его Богу, как сердце его предка Давида.
ru.R: Он совершал все те же грехи, что и его отец до него. Он не был полностью верен {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, своему Богу, как был верен его предок Давид.

ja.L: そして彼は、彼より前に父が行ったすべての罪のうちを歩み、彼の心は、父ダビデの心のようには、彼の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}と共に全きものではなかった。
ja.B: 彼は、父が彼より前に犯したすべての罪のうちを歩み、その心は、先祖ダビデの心のようには、彼の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に全く従うものではなかった。
ja.R: アビヤムは、父がその前に犯したのと同じ罪を、すべて犯しました。先祖ダビデとは違って、自分の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に心から忠実ではありませんでした。

uk.L: І ходив він у всіх гріхах свого батька, які той чинив перед ним, і не було його серце цілим з {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, його Богом, як серце Давида, його батька.
uk.B: Він ходив у всіх гріхах, які до нього чинив його батько, і його серце не було цілком віддане {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, його Богові, як серце його предка Давида.
uk.R: Він чинив усі ті самі гріхи, що й його батько до нього. Він не був цілком вірний {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, своєму Богові, як був вірний його предок Давид.

decisions.choice: walked in all the sins of his father: lived by the same sins as Rehoboam
decisions.reason: To walk in something is to live by it. Rehoboam's reign had allowed high places, standing stones, Asherah poles and shrine prostitutes throughout Judah (14:22-24), and Abijam carried on the same ways.

decisions.choice: his heart was not whole with Yahweh: his loyalty to Yahweh was divided
decisions.reason: The word means whole, complete or at peace. A heart that is whole with Yahweh belongs to him undivided. The same words were said of Solomon in his old age, when his heart was turned toward other gods (11:4). Asa's heart, by contrast, is whole with Yahweh (verse 14).

decisions.choice: David his father: his ancestor David
decisions.reason: David was Abijam's great-grandfather. "Father" in Hebrew also means a forefather, and the books of Kings measure each king of Judah against David (verses 5, 11).

decisions.choice: wholly given to
decisions.reason: Balanced turns "whole with" into "wholly given to", which keeps the picture of an undivided heart. Readable says what the idiom means: "completely loyal".

decisions.choice: his ancestor David
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "ancestor" for "father" here (m3), as they do wherever David is called the father of a later king; Literal keeps "father".

decisions.choice: "su antepasado David" (B, R); "David su padre" (L)
decisions.reason: David was Abijam's great-grandfather; Balanced and Readable say "antepasado", as the English says "ancestor".

decisions.choice: "entièrement à" (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of a whole heart with a natural French phrase; Readable says "entièrement fidèle".

decisions.choice: babu yake
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "baba yake" (his father); Balanced and Readable say "babu yake", since David was Abijam's ancestor, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "마음이 주와 함께 온전하다" (L), "마음이 주께 온전히 바쳐지다" (B), "주께 온전히 충성하다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "whole with"; Balanced keeps the heart, Readable says plainly that it is loyalty. The same wording returns for Asa in verse 14.

decisions.choice: "그의 아버지 다윗" (L), "그의 조상 다윗" (B, R)
decisions.reason: David was Abijam's great-grandfather; Literal keeps the Hebrew "father" and the other levels say "조상".

decisions.choice: íntegro para com (L); inteiramente dedicado a (B); totalmente fiel a (R); Davi, seu pai (L), o seu antepassado Davi (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also verse 14): the undivided heart (m2) is "íntegro" at Literal, the word for something whole, "inteiramente dedicado" at Balanced and "totalmente fiel" at Readable; "perfeito" would claim more than the Hebrew does. David is "seu pai" at Literal and "o seu antepassado" at Balanced and Readable (m3).

decisions.choice: "ልቡም ... ከአምላኩ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ጋር ፍጹም አልነበረም" (Literal); "... ፈጽሞ የተሰጠ" (Balanced); "ፍጹም ታማኝ" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The whole heart (shalem) of the kings recurs (verse 14; 8:61; 11:4); one wording at each level. "አባቱ ዳዊት" at Literal, "ቅድመ አያቱ ዳዊት" (his ancestor) at Balanced and Readable, as the English.
David was his ancestor (meaning m3); as 2 Samuel for father meaning grandfather, Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: "Давида, его отца" (L); "его предка Давида" (B, R)
decisions.reason: David was Abijam's great-grandfather (m3); Literal keeps the Hebrew "father", the other levels say "предок", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "всецело с ГОСПОДОМ" (L); "всецело предано ГОСПОДУ" (B)
levavo shalem 'im YHWH "…と共に全きもの" (L), "…に全く従うもの" (B), "…に心から忠実" (R)
decisions.reason: Undivided loyalty to God; the same words for Asa in 15:14.

decisions.choice: David aviv "父ダビデ" (L), "先祖ダビデ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: David was his ancestor, as the English Balanced and Readable say.

source.text: כִּ֚י לְמַ֣עַן דָּוִ֔ד נָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהָ֥יו ל֛וֹ נִ֖יר בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְהָקִ֤ים אֶת־בְּנוֹ֙ אַחֲרָ֔יו וּֽלְהַעֲמִ֖יד אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: But for [the] sake of David gave Yahweh his God to him a lamp in Jerusalem, to raise up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem,

en.L: But for the sake of David, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, by raising up his son after him and by establishing Jerusalem,
en.B: Yet for David's sake {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, setting up his son to rule after him and keeping Jerusalem secure,
en.R: But because of David, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God kept a lamp burning for him in Jerusalem. He made Abijam's son king after him and kept Jerusalem safe.

es.L: Pero por amor a David, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios le dio una lámpara en Jerusalén, levantando a su hijo después de él y afirmando a Jerusalén,
es.B: Sin embargo, por amor a David, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios le dio una lámpara en Jerusalén, poniendo a su hijo a reinar después de él y manteniendo segura a Jerusalén,
es.R: Pero por causa de David, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios mantuvo encendida para él una lámpara en Jerusalén. Hizo rey al hijo de Abiam después de él y mantuvo a salvo a Jerusalén.

fr.L: Mais à cause de David, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu lui donna une lampe à Jérusalem, en suscitant son fils après lui et en affermissant Jérusalem,
fr.B: Pourtant, à cause de David, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu lui donna une lampe à Jérusalem, en établissant son fils après lui et en maintenant Jérusalem,
fr.R: Mais à cause de David, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu a laissé une lampe allumée pour lui à Jérusalem. Il a fait du fils d’Abiyam le roi après lui, et il a protégé Jérusalem.

sw.L: Lakini kwa ajili ya Daudi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake alimpa taa katika Yerusalemu, kwa kumwinua mwanawe baada yake na kwa kuuimarisha Yerusalemu,
sw.B: Hata hivyo, kwa ajili ya Daudi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake alimpa taa katika Yerusalemu, akamsimamisha mwanawe atawale baada yake na kuulinda Yerusalemu imara,
sw.R: Lakini kwa sababu ya Daudi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake aliendelea kumwashia taa katika Yerusalemu. Alimfanya mwana wa Abiyamu kuwa mfalme baada yake, akaulinda Yerusalemu salama.

vi.L: Nhưng vì cớ Đa-vít, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông ban cho ông một ngọn đèn tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, bằng cách dấy con trai ông lên sau ông và làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem được vững lập,
vi.B: Dù vậy, vì cớ Đa-vít, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của vua ban cho vua một ngọn đèn tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, lập con trai vua lên nối ngôi và giữ cho Giê-ru-sa-lem được vững an,
vi.R: Nhưng vì Đa-vít, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của vua vẫn giữ cho ngọn đèn của vua tiếp tục cháy sáng tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ngài lập con trai A-bi-giam lên làm vua sau ông và giữ cho Giê-ru-sa-lem được an toàn.

ko.L: 그러나 다윗을 위하여 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘에서 그에게 등불을 주셨으니, 그의 뒤에 그의 아들을 세우시고 예루살렘을 굳게 세우셨다.
ko.B: 그러나 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 다윗을 생각하셔서 예루살렘에서 그에게 등불을 주셨다. 그의 뒤를 이어 그의 아들을 세우시고 예루살렘을 든든히 지키셨다.
ko.R: 그러나 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 다윗 때문에 예루살렘에서 그의 등불이 꺼지지 않게 하셨다. 그분께서는 아비얌의 아들을 그의 뒤를 이을 왕으로 세우시고, 예루살렘을 안전하게 지키셨다.

pt.L: Mas, por amor de Davi, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, lhe deu uma lâmpada em Jerusalém, levantando o seu filho depois dele e firmando Jerusalém,
pt.B: Mesmo assim, por amor de Davi, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, lhe deu uma lâmpada em Jerusalém, pondo o seu filho para reinar depois dele e mantendo Jerusalém segura,
pt.R: Mas, por causa de Davi, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, manteve uma lâmpada acesa para ele em Jerusalém. Ele fez o filho de Abiam rei depois dele e manteve Jerusalém em segurança.

am.L: ነገር ግን ስለ ዳዊት አምላኩ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ልጁን ከእርሱ በኋላ በማስነሣትና ኢየሩሳሌምን በማጽናት በኢየሩሳሌም መብራት ሰጠው፤
am.B: ይሁን እንጂ ስለ ዳዊት ሲል አምላኩ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእርሱ በኋላ ልጁን በዙፋን በማስነሣትና ኢየሩሳሌምን በማጽናት በኢየሩሳሌም መብራት ሰጠው፤
am.R: ነገር ግን አምላኩ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስለ ዳዊት ሲል በኢየሩሳሌም መብራቱ እንዳይጠፋ አደረገለት። ከአብያ በኋላ ልጁን አነገሠ፤ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ጠበቃት።

hi.L: पर दाऊद के कारण {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उसके परमेश्वर ने यरूशलेम में उसे एक दीपक दिया, कि उसके बाद उसके पुत्र को खड़ा करें और यरूशलेम को स्थिर रखें,
hi.B: फिर भी दाऊद के कारण {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उसके परमेश्वर ने यरूशलेम में उसे एक दीपक दिया: उन्होंने उसके बाद उसके पुत्र को राजा ठहराया और यरूशलेम को सुरक्षित रखा,
hi.R: पर दाऊद के कारण {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उसके परमेश्वर ने यरूशलेम में उसका दीपक जलता रहने दिया। उन्होंने अबिय्याम के बाद उसके बेटे को राजा बनाया और यरूशलेम को सुरक्षित रखा।

ru.L: Но ради Давида {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, его Бог, дал ему светильник в Иерусалиме, воздвигнув его сына после него и утвердив Иерусалим,
ru.B: Но ради Давида {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, его Бог, дал ему светильник в Иерусалиме: поставил его сына править после него и сохранил Иерусалим,
ru.R: Но ради Давида {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, его Бог, поддерживал для него светильник в Иерусалиме. Он сделал сына Авияма царём после него и защитил Иерусалим.

ja.L: しかし、ダビデのために、彼の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はエルサレムで彼に一つのともしびを与え、彼の後に彼の子を立て、エルサレムを堅く立たせられた。
ja.B: しかしダビデのために、彼の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はエルサレムで彼にともしびを与え、彼の後に子を立てて、エルサレムを堅く保たれた。
ja.R: けれども、ダビデのために、アビヤムの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、エルサレムでダビデの家のともしびを絶やさないようにされました。アビヤムの後に、その息子を王にし、エルサレムを守られたのです。

uk.L: Але заради Давида {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, його Бог, дав йому світильник у Єрусалимі, підняв його сина після нього і утвердив Єрусалим,
uk.B: Проте заради Давида {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, його Бог, дав йому світильник у Єрусалимі: поставив його сина царювати після нього і зберіг Єрусалим непохитним,
uk.R: Але заради Давида {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, його Бог, не дав згаснути його світильникові в Єрусалимі. Він зробив царем Авіямового сина після нього і беріг Єрусалим.

decisions.choice: but: in contrast to Abijam's sins
decisions.reason: The word sets what Yahweh did against what Abijam deserved (verse 3). Yahweh did not end David's line because of Abijam's sins.

decisions.choice: for David's sake: because of Yahweh's promise to David
decisions.reason: Yahweh had promised David that his house and his kingdom would last (2 Samuel 7:12-16), and he had said he would keep one tribe for Solomon's son for David's sake (11:12-13, 32).

decisions.choice: a lamp: a descendant who keeps the family line alive
decisions.reason: A lamp left burning in a house is a sign that someone still lives there. Yahweh had promised that David would always have a lamp before him in Jerusalem (11:36). The verse explains the lamp: a son to reign after Abijam, and a city kept standing.

decisions.choice: to raise up ... and to establish: the two ways the lamp was given
decisions.reason: The two verbs say how Yahweh gave the lamp: by raising up Abijam's son as king and by keeping Jerusalem firm. The sentence goes on in verse 5 with the reason.

decisions.choice: kept a lamp burning ... made Abijam's son king
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture of the lamp but makes it a lamp kept burning, and names Abijam so that "his son" is clear. It ends the sentence here and starts verse 5 afresh.

decisions.choice: taa
decisions.reason: The "lamp" is kept at every level, as the English keeps it; the meaning decision explains that it is a descendant who keeps David's line alive.

decisions.choice: "ngọn đèn" kept at every level
decisions.reason: The lamp is a picture of a descendant who keeps David's line alive; the picture is kept, as the English keeps it, and the meaning decision explains it.

decisions.choice: uma lâmpada (L, B); uma lâmpada acesa (R)
decisions.reason: The lamp that shows a house still lived in (m3) keeps the word of 11:36, "lâmpada", the ordinary word for an oil lamp; Readable adds "acesa", as the English "kept a lamp burning".

decisions.choice: "መብራት" (lamp) at every level
decisions.reason: The picture of 11:36 is kept; Readable says that the lamp is not put out, as the English Readable keeps it burning.

decisions.choice: "दीपक"
decisions.reason: A descendant who keeps the line alive (meaning m3), as 11:36.

decisions.choice: "светильник"
decisions.reason: As 11:36: a descendant who keeps the line alive (m3).

decisions.choice: nir "ともしび" at every level
decisions.reason: A descendant who keeps David's line alive (11:36); Readable says the lamp was kept burning, as the English Readable does.

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה דָוִ֛ד אֶת־הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־סָ֞ר מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֗הוּ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֔יו רַ֕ק בִּדְבַ֖ר אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַחִתִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: because did David the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh, and not he turned aside from all that he commanded him all [the] days of his life, only in [the] matter of Uriah the Hittite.

en.L: because David did the right in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and did not turn aside from anything that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commanded him all the days of his life, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
en.B: because David had done what was right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and had not turned aside from anything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commanded him as long as he lived, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
en.R: This was because David had done what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was right. All his life he had never turned away from anything God commanded him, except in what he did to Uriah the Hittite.

es.L: porque David había hecho lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y no se había apartado de nada de lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le mandó en todos los días de su vida, excepto en el asunto de Urías el hitita.
es.B: porque David había hecho lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y no se había apartado de nada de lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le mandó mientras vivió, excepto en el asunto de Urías el hitita.
es.R: Esto fue porque David había hecho lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. En toda su vida nunca se apartó de nada de lo que Dios le mandó, excepto en lo que le hizo a Urías el hitita.

fr.L: parce que David avait fait ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ne s’était détourné de rien de ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui avait commandé tous les jours de sa vie, excepté dans l’affaire d’Urie le Hittite.
fr.B: parce que David avait fait ce qui est juste aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et ne s’était détourné de rien de ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui avait commandé pendant toute sa vie, sauf dans l’affaire d’Urie le Hittite.
fr.R: C’était parce que David avait fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare bon. De toute sa vie, il ne s’était jamais écarté de ce que Dieu lui avait commandé, sauf dans ce qu’il avait fait à Urie le Hittite.

sw.L: kwa sababu Daudi alifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wala hakugeuka kando na lolote alilomwamuru siku zote za maisha yake, isipokuwa katika jambo la Uria Mhiti.
sw.B: kwa sababu Daudi alikuwa amefanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wala hakuacha lolote alilomwamuru maisha yake yote, isipokuwa katika jambo la Uria Mhiti.
sw.R: Hii ilikuwa kwa sababu Daudi alikuwa amefanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mema. Maisha yake yote hakuacha kufanya lolote ambalo Mungu alimwamuru, isipokuwa yale aliyomtendea Uria Mhiti.

vi.L: vì Đa-vít đã làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và trọn đời mình không lìa bỏ điều gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền cho ông, ngoại trừ việc U-ri người Hê-tít.
vi.B: vì Đa-vít đã làm điều ngay thẳng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và suốt đời không hề làm trái điều gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} truyền cho mình, chỉ trừ việc U-ri người Hê-tít.
vi.R: Đó là vì Đa-vít đã làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là phải. Suốt đời ông không hề bỏ điều gì Đức Chúa Trời truyền cho ông, chỉ trừ việc ông đã làm đối với U-ri người Hê-tít.

ko.L: 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 올바른 일을 했고, 헷 사람 우리야의 일 말고는 그의 평생 모든 날 동안 그분께서 그에게 명령하신 모든 것에서 벗어나지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 올바른 일을 했고, 헷 사람 우리야의 일 말고는 평생 그분께서 명령하신 모든 것에서 벗어나지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했기 때문이다. 다윗은 평생 하나님께서 명령하신 일에서 한 번도 벗어나지 않았다. 다만 헷 사람 우리야에게 한 일은 예외였다.

pt.L: porque Davi fez o reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e não se desviou de nada do que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe ordenou todos os dias da sua vida, a não ser no caso de Urias, o hitita.
pt.B: porque Davi tinha feito o que era reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e não tinha se desviado de nada do que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe ordenara durante toda a sua vida, a não ser no caso de Urias, o hitita.
pt.R: Isso aconteceu porque Davi tinha feito o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava certo. Durante toda a vida ele nunca deixou de fazer nada do que Deus lhe mandou, a não ser no que fez com Urias, o hitita.

am.L: ዳዊት {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ዓይን ቅን የሆነውን አድርጓልና፤ ከኬጢያዊው ከኦርዮ ነገር በቀር በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ ካዘዘው ነገር ሁሉ ፈቀቅ አላለምና።
am.B: ይህም ዳዊት {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ቅን የሆነውን ስላደረገና ከኬጢያዊው ከኦርዮ ነገር በቀር በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ ካዘዘው ነገር ሁሉ ፈቀቅ ስላላለ ነው።
am.R: ይህም የሆነው ዳዊት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ትክክል ነው የሚለውን ስላደረገ ነው። በኬጢያዊው በኦርዮ ላይ ካደረገው በቀር በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ካዘዘው ነገር ፈቀቅ ብሎ አያውቅም።

hi.L: क्योंकि दाऊद ने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में ठीक था, और जो कुछ उन्होंने उसे आज्ञा दी थी उससे वह जीवन भर न मुड़ा, केवल हित्ती ऊरिय्याह की बात में।
hi.B: क्योंकि दाऊद ने वह किया था जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में ठीक था, और जीवन भर उनकी किसी भी आज्ञा से नहीं मुड़ा था, केवल हित्ती ऊरिय्याह के मामले को छोड़।
hi.R: यह इसलिए था कि दाऊद ने वह किया था जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में ठीक था। उसने जीवन भर परमेश्वर की किसी भी आज्ञा को नहीं टाला, केवल उस बात को छोड़ जो उसने हित्ती ऊरिय्याह के साथ की।

ru.L: потому что Давид делал то, что было правильным в глазах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и не уклонялся от всего, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} повелел ему, во все дни своей жизни, кроме дела Урии хетта.
ru.B: потому что Давид делал то, что было правильным в глазах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и всю свою жизнь не уклонялся ни от чего, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} повелел ему, кроме того, что случилось с Урией хеттом.
ru.R: Это было потому, что Давид делал то, что нравилось {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Всю жизнь он ни в чём не отступал от того, что повелел ему Бог, кроме того, что он сделал с Урией хеттом.

ja.L: ダビデが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の目に正しいことを行い、その生涯のすべての日々、主が彼に命じられたすべてのことから外れなかったからである。ただ、ヘト人ウリヤのことだけは別であった。
ja.B: ダビデは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の目に正しいとされることを行い、ヘト人ウリヤのことを除けば、生涯、主が命じられたどんなことからも外れなかったからである。
ja.R: ダビデが、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が正しいと言われることをしたからです。ダビデは生きている間ずっと、神が命じられたことから離れませんでした。ただ、ヘト人ウリヤにしたことだけは別でした。

uk.L: бо Давид робив правильне в очах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і не відступав ні від чого, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наказав йому, по всі дні свого життя, крім справи Урії хетеянина.
uk.B: бо Давид робив те, що було правильне в очах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і не відступав ні від чого, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наказав йому, поки жив, — крім справи Урії хетеянина.
uk.R: Це було тому, що Давид робив те, що подобалося {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}. Усе своє життя він ніколи не відступав від того, що Бог наказав йому, крім того, що він зробив Урії хетеянинові.

decisions.choice: did what was right in Yahweh's eyes: the verdict for a faithful king
decisions.reason: This is the good verdict of the regnal formula, the opposite of "did what was evil in Yahweh's eyes" (14:22). David is the measure for the kings after him (verse 11).

decisions.choice: except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite: David's adultery with Bathsheba and the killing of her husband
decisions.reason: David took Bathsheba, Uriah's wife, and had Uriah killed in battle (2 Samuel 11). Nathan's rebuke followed (2 Samuel 12:1-14). The narrator names it as the one great exception to David's faithfulness.

decisions.choice: God commanded him
decisions.reason: Readable says "God" in place of the pronoun, so the reader does not take "he" for David.

decisions.choice: "hizo lo recto a los ojos del SEÑOR" (L, B); "hizo lo que agrada al SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: The good verdict as the Kings and Chronicles note sets for Spanish, one wording per level.

decisions.choice: "ce qui est droit aux yeux du SEIGNEUR" (L); "ce qui est juste aux yeux du SEIGNEUR" (B); "ce que le SEIGNEUR déclare bon" (R)
decisions.reason: The good verdict as the Kings and Chronicles terms note words it, one wording per level.

decisions.choice: alifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa BWANA (Literal, Balanced); alifanya yale BWANA aliyoyaona kuwa mema (Readable)
decisions.reason: The good verdict has one wording per level through these books, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt CHÚA" (L); "trước mặt CHÚA" (B); "làm điều CHÚA cho là phải" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's good verdict at each level, used for every king in Kings.

decisions.choice: "주의 눈에 올바른 일을 했다" (L), "주 보시기에 올바른 일을 했다" (B), "주께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했다" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's verdict for a faithful king, held through the block.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ዓይን ቅን የሆነውን አደረገ" (Literal); "... ፊት ቅን የሆነውን አደረገ" (Balanced); "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ትክክል ነው የሚለውን አደረገ" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The good verdict mirrors the evil one of the terms list (14:22), so the two read as a pair through Kings. "ኬጢያዊው ኦርዮ" as the Amharic 2 Samuel 11.

decisions.choice: "उसने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में ठीक था"
decisions.reason: The good verdict of the history-books note, word for word at every level (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span ("उन्होंने", "उनकी")
decisions.reason: The Hindi text has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7); honorific forms carry respect for God at every level. The same in verse 29.

decisions.choice: "हित्ती ऊरिय्याह"
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 11:3 and Matthew 1:6 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "делал то, что было правильным в глазах ГОСПОДА" (L, B); "делал то, что нравилось ГОСПОДУ" (R)
decisions.reason: The good verdict formula of the history terms note, first used here of David as the measure (m1), then of Asa in verse 11.

decisions.choice: "Урия хетт" (gen. "Урии хетта")
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 11:3 in Russian.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の目に正しいことを行う" (L), "…の目に正しいとされることを行う" (B), "…が正しいと言われることを行う" (R)
decisions.reason: The good verdict, the counterpart of the evil one (14:22); as fixed for Kings at 1KI 11:33.

decisions.choice: Uriah the Hittite "ヘト人ウリヤ"
decisions.reason: Uriah as MAT 1:6; Hittites ヘト人 as 1KI 9:20.

source.text: וּמִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֧ה בֵין־רְחַבְעָ֛ם וּבֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָ֖ם כָּל־יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And war was between Rehoboam and between Jeroboam all [the] days of his life.

en.L: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
en.B: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of Abijam's life.
en.R: The war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam went on as long as Abijam lived.

es.L: Y hubo guerra entre Roboam y Jeroboam todos los días de su vida.
es.B: Hubo guerra entre Roboam y Jeroboam todos los días de la vida de Abiam.
es.R: La guerra entre Roboam y Jeroboam continuó mientras Abiam vivió.

fr.L: Et il y eut guerre entre Roboam et Jéroboam tous les jours de sa vie.
fr.B: Il y eut la guerre entre Roboam et Jéroboam pendant toute la vie d’Abiyam.
fr.R: La guerre entre Roboam et Jéroboam a continué aussi longtemps qu’Abiyam a vécu.

sw.L: Kulikuwa na vita kati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu siku zote za maisha yake.
sw.B: Kulikuwa na vita kati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu siku zote za maisha ya Abiyamu.
sw.R: Vita kati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu viliendelea muda wote Abiyamu alipokuwa hai.

vi.L: Giữa Rô-bô-am và Giê-rô-bô-am có chiến tranh trọn đời ông.
vi.B: Giữa Rô-bô-am và Giê-rô-bô-am có chiến tranh suốt đời A-bi-giam.
vi.R: Cuộc chiến giữa Rô-bô-am và Giê-rô-bô-am kéo dài suốt đời A-bi-giam.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암과 여로보암 사이에 그의 평생 모든 날 동안 전쟁이 있었다.
ko.B: 르호보암과 여로보암 사이에는 아비얌이 사는 동안 내내 전쟁이 있었다.
ko.R: 르호보암과 여로보암 사이의 전쟁은 아비얌이 사는 동안 계속되었다.

pt.L: E houve guerra entre Roboão e Jeroboão todos os dias da sua vida.
pt.B: Houve guerra entre Roboão e Jeroboão durante toda a vida de Abiam.
pt.R: A guerra entre Roboão e Jeroboão continuou enquanto Abiam viveu.

am.L: በሮብዓምና በኢዮርብዓም መካከልም በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ ጦርነት ነበረ።
am.B: በሮብዓምና በኢዮርብዓም መካከል በአብያ ዕድሜ ዘመን ሁሉ ጦርነት ነበረ።
am.R: በሮብዓምና በኢዮርብዓም መካከል የነበረው ጦርነት አብያ በሕይወት እስከ ኖረበት ጊዜ ድረስ ቀጠለ።

hi.L: और रहबाम और यारोबाम के बीच उसके जीवन भर युद्ध होता रहा।
hi.B: अबिय्याम के जीवन भर रहबाम और यारोबाम के बीच युद्ध होता रहा।
hi.R: जब तक अबिय्याम जीवित रहा, रहबाम और यारोबाम के बीच का युद्ध चलता रहा।

ru.L: И была война между Ровоамом и Иеровоамом во все дни его жизни.
ru.B: Война между Ровоамом и Иеровоамом шла во все дни жизни Авияма.
ru.R: Война между Ровоамом и Иеровоамом продолжалась всё время, пока жил Авиям.

ja.L: そしてレハブアムとヤロブアムの間には、彼の生涯のすべての日々、戦いがあった。
ja.B: アビヤムの生涯の間、レハブアムとヤロブアムの間には戦いがあった。
ja.R: アビヤムが生きている間ずっと、レハブアムとヤロブアムの戦いは続きました。

uk.L: І була війна між Ровоамом і Єровоамом по всі дні його життя.
uk.B: Між Ровоамом і Єровоамом була війна по всі дні Авіямового життя.
uk.R: Війна між Ровоамом і Єровоамом тривала, поки жив Авіям.

decisions.choice: the verse repeats 14:30 inside Abijam's reign
decisions.reason: These words are almost the same as 14:30, which closes Rehoboam's reign, and some ancient Greek copies do not have the verse here. It may have been copied here from 14:30. The Hebrew text has it, and it fits with verse 7: the war that began under Rehoboam went on under his son.

decisions.choice: his life: Abijam's lifetime
decisions.reason: Since the verse stands in Abijam's reign, "his" most likely means Abijam: the war between the two kingdoms that started under Rehoboam lasted all through Abijam's life too (verse 7). It could also mean Rehoboam's life, as in 14:30.

decisions.choice: Abijam's life
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Abijam for "his" (m2), since a bare "his" after two names would leave the reader guessing. Literal keeps "his".

decisions.choice: "アビヤムの生涯" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "His life" is Abijam's, as the English Balanced and Readable say; the verse repeats 14:30.

source.text: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י אֲבִיָּם֙ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה הֲלֽוֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּמִלְחָמָ֥ה הָיְתָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין אֲבִיָּ֖ם וּבֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Abijam and all that he did, [are] not they written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of [the] kings of Judah? And war was between Abijam and between Jeroboam.

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Abijam and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
en.B: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Judah. There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
en.R: Everything else Abijam did is written in the history of the kings of Judah. There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

es.L: Y el resto de los hechos de Abiam y todo lo que hizo, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Judá? Y hubo guerra entre Abiam y Jeroboam.
es.B: Los demás hechos de Abiam y todo lo que hizo están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Judá. Hubo guerra entre Abiam y Jeroboam.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Abiam está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Judá. Hubo guerra entre Abiam y Jeroboam.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes d’Abiyam et tout ce qu’il a fait, n’est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda ? Et il y eut guerre entre Abiyam et Jéroboam.
fr.B: Le reste des actes d’Abiyam et tout ce qu’il a fait est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda. Il y eut la guerre entre Abiyam et Jéroboam.
fr.R: Tout ce qu’Abiyam a fait d’autre a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda. Il y a eu la guerre entre Abiyam et Jéroboam.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Abiyamu na yote aliyoyafanya, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Yuda? Na kulikuwa na vita kati ya Abiyamu na Yeroboamu.
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Abiyamu na yote aliyoyafanya yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Yuda. Kulikuwa na vita kati ya Abiyamu na Yeroboamu.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyofanya Abiyamu yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Yuda. Kulikuwa na vita kati ya Abiyamu na Yeroboamu.

vi.L: Các việc khác của A-bi-giam và mọi điều ông đã làm, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Giu-đa sao? Giữa A-bi-giam và Giê-rô-bô-am cũng có chiến tranh.
vi.B: Các việc khác của A-bi-giam và mọi điều vua đã làm đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Giu-đa. Giữa A-bi-giam và Giê-rô-bô-am có chiến tranh.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác A-bi-giam đã làm đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Giu-đa. A-bi-giam và Giê-rô-bô-am đánh nhau.

ko.L: 그리고 아비얌의 나머지 일들과 그가 행한 모든 것은 유다 왕들의 날들의 일들을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐? 그리고 아비얌과 여로보암 사이에 전쟁이 있었다.
ko.B: 아비얌의 나머지 행적과 그가 한 모든 일은 유다 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다. 아비얌과 여로보암 사이에는 전쟁이 있었다.
ko.R: 아비얌이 한 다른 모든 일은 유다 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다. 아비얌과 여로보암은 서로 싸웠다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Abiam e tudo o que ele fez, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá? E houve guerra entre Abiam e Jeroboão.
pt.B: Os demais atos de Abiam e tudo o que ele fez estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Judá. Houve guerra entre Abiam e Jeroboão.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Abiam fez está escrito na história dos reis de Judá. Houve guerra entre Abiam e Jeroboão.

am.L: የቀረውም የአብያ ሥራ፣ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፣ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን? በአብያና በኢዮርብዓም መካከልም ጦርነት ነበረ።
am.B: የቀረው የአብያ ሥራና ያደረገው ሁሉ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፏል። በአብያና በኢዮርብዓም መካከልም ጦርነት ነበረ።
am.R: አብያ ያደረገው ሌላው ነገር ሁሉ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ ተጽፏል። በአብያና በኢዮርብዓም መካከልም ጦርነት ነበረ።

hi.L: और अबिय्याम की बाक़ी बातें और जो कुछ उसने किया, क्या वे यहूदा के राजाओं के इतिहास की पुस्तक में नहीं लिखी हैं? और अबिय्याम और यारोबाम के बीच युद्ध होता रहा।
hi.B: अबिय्याम के बाक़ी काम और जो कुछ उसने किया, वे यहूदा के राजाओं के इतिहास की पुस्तक में लिखे हैं। अबिय्याम और यारोबाम के बीच युद्ध होता रहा।
hi.R: अबिय्याम ने जो कुछ और किया, वह सब यहूदा के राजाओं के इतिहास में लिखा है। अबिय्याम और यारोबाम के बीच युद्ध होता रहा।

ru.L: А прочие дела Авияма и всё, что он сделал, — разве это не записано в книге летописи царей Иуды? И была война между Авиямом и Иеровоамом.
ru.B: Прочие дела Авияма и всё, что он сделал, записаны в книге летописи царей Иуды. Между Авиямом и Иеровоамом шла война.
ru.R: Обо всём остальном, что сделал Авиям, написано в летописи царей Иуды. Между Авиямом и Иеровоамом шла война.

ja.L: アビヤムのその他の事績と、彼が行ったすべてのことは、ユダの王たちの年代記の書に記されているではないか？そしてアビヤムとヤロブアムの間には戦いがあった。
ja.B: アビヤムのその他の事績と、彼が行ったすべてのことは、ユダの王の年代記に記されている。アビヤムとヤロブアムの間には戦いがあった。
ja.R: アビヤムがしたほかのことは、ユダの王たちの記録に書かれています。アビヤムとヤロブアムの間には、戦いがありました。

uk.L: А решта справ Авіяма і все, що він робив, — хіба це не записано в книзі хронік царів Юдеї? І була війна між Авіямом і Єровоамом.
uk.B: Решта діянь Авіяма і все, що він робив, записані в книзі хронік царів Юдеї. Між Авіямом і Єровоамом була війна.
uk.R: Усе інше, що зробив Авіям, записано в історії царів Юдеї. Між Авіямом і Єровоамом була війна.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah: a royal record the writer could consult
decisions.reason: As at 14:29, the writer sends the reader to a fuller written record of Judah's kings, now lost. The question "are they not written ...?" means "they are written".

decisions.choice: war between Abijam and Jeroboam: told in 2 Chronicles 13
decisions.reason: Chronicles tells of a battle in this war in which Abijah defeated Jeroboam (2 Chronicles 13:2-20).

decisions.choice: a statement in place of the question
decisions.reason: As in the sources formula throughout these books, Balanced and Readable state as a fact what the Hebrew asks as a question; Literal keeps the question.

decisions.choice: The source formula: question at Literal, statement at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As 14:29: the history-books note's question at Literal; Balanced and Readable state what it means, as the English does. The same in verses 23 and 31.

decisions.choice: the source formula, as 14:29
decisions.reason: Question at Literal, statement at Balanced and Readable, as the English.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב אֲבִיָּם֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Abijam with his fathers, and they buried him in [the] city of David, and reigned Asa his son in his place.

en.L: And Abijam lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David, and Asa his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Then Abijam rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. His son Asa became king in his place.
en.R: Then Abijam died and was buried in the City of David. His son Asa became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Abiam con sus padres, y lo sepultaron en la ciudad de David, y reinó en su lugar Asá su hijo.
es.B: Luego Abiam descansó con sus antepasados y fue sepultado en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Asá reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Luego Abiam murió y fue sepultado en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Asá lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Abiyam se coucha avec ses pères, et on l’enterra dans la cité de David, et Asa son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Puis Abiyam reposa avec ses ancêtres, et on l’enterra dans la cité de David. Et Asa son fils régna à sa place.
fr.R: Ensuite Abiyam est mort et il a été enterré dans la cité de David. Son fils Asa est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Abiyamu akalala pamoja na baba zake, wakamzika katika mji wa Daudi, na Asa mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Kisha Abiyamu akapumzika pamoja na babu zake, akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Asa akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Kisha Abiyamu akafa, akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Asa akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: A-bi-giam nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và người ta chôn ông trong thành Đa-vít; A-sa con trai ông trị vì thay ông.
vi.B: A-bi-giam an giấc cùng tổ tiên và được chôn trong thành Đa-vít. A-sa con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: A-bi-giam qua đời và được chôn trong thành Đa-vít. A-sa con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 아비얌이 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 사람들이 그를 다윗 성에 묻었다. 그리고 그의 아들 아사가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 아비얌은 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 다윗 성에 묻혔다. 그의 아들 아사가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 아비얌은 죽었고, 다윗 성에 묻혔다. 그의 아들 아사가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Abiam descansou com os seus pais, e o sepultaram na Cidade de Davi, e Asa, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Então Abiam descansou com os seus antepassados e foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi. E o seu filho Asa reinou em seu lugar.
pt.R: Então Abiam morreu e foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi. O seu filho Asa se tornou rei depois dele.

am.L: አብያም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም አሳ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
am.B: ከዚያም አብያ ሞተ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ ተቀበረ። ልጁም አሳ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
am.R: ከዚያም አብያ ሞተ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ ተቀበረ። ልጁም አሳ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

hi.L: और अबिय्याम अपने पूर्वजों के साथ सो गया, और उन्होंने उसे दाऊद के नगर में मिट्टी दी; और उसका पुत्र आसा उसके स्थान पर राज्य करने लगा।
hi.B: तब अबिय्याम अपने पूर्वजों के साथ सो गया, और उसे दाऊद के नगर में मिट्टी दी गई। उसका पुत्र आसा उसके स्थान पर राजा बना।
hi.R: फिर अबिय्याम की मृत्यु हुई, और उसे दाऊद के नगर में दफ़नाया गया। उसके बाद उसका बेटा आसा राजा बना।

ru.L: И почил Авиям со своими отцами, и похоронили его в городе Давида; и воцарился Аса, его сын, вместо него.
ru.B: Авиям почил со своими отцами и был похоронен в городе Давида. Вместо него воцарился его сын Аса.
ru.R: Потом Авиям умер, и его похоронили в городе Давида. Царём после него стал его сын Аса.

ja.L: そしてアビヤムは先祖たちと共に眠り、人々は彼をダビデの町に葬った。そして彼の子アサが彼に代わって王となった。
ja.B: アビヤムは先祖のもとで眠りにつき、ダビデの町に葬られた。そして、彼の子アサが代わって王となった。
ja.R: アビヤムは亡くなり、ダビデの町に葬られました。そして、アビヤムの息子アサが、次の王になりました。

uk.L: І ліг Авіям зі своїми батьками, і поховали його в Місті Давида; і зацарював Аса, його син, замість нього.
uk.B: Потім Авіям спочив зі своїми батьками і був похований у Місті Давида. Його син Аса став царем замість нього.
uk.R: Потім Авіям помер і був похований у Місті Давида. Царем після нього став його син Аса.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The death formula of Kings, as at 2:10 and 14:31.

decisions.choice: Asa his son: the next king of Judah
decisions.reason: 2 Chronicles 13:23 reports the same succession. On Asa's mother, see verse 10.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula is worded the same way at each level throughout Kings. Balanced and Readable say "was buried" because the Hebrew "they buried him" names no one in particular.

decisions.choice: "Asá"
decisions.reason: The Kings and Chronicles terms table's form, also Matthew 1:7-8 in the published Spanish.

decisions.choice: "et Asa son fils régna à sa place" (L, B); "Son fils Asa est devenu roi à sa place" (R)
decisions.reason: The successor formula of the Kings and Chronicles terms note, the same for every king.

decisions.choice: "आसा"
decisions.reason: As Matthew 1:7-8 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "Аса" (gen. "Асы")
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian form.

decisions.choice: Asa "アサ"
decisions.reason: As MAT 1:7-8.

source.text: וּבִשְׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְיָרָבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֥ךְ אָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And in [the] year twenty of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa king of Judah.

en.L: And in [the] twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa king of Judah reigned.
en.B: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa became king of Judah.
en.R: Asa became king of Judah in the twentieth year that Jeroboam was king of Israel.

es.L: Y en el año veinte de Jeroboam rey de Israel, comenzó a reinar Asá rey de Judá.
es.B: En el año veinte de Jeroboam rey de Israel, Asá comenzó a reinar sobre Judá.
es.R: Asá llegó a ser rey de Judá en el año veinte del reinado de Jeroboam en Israel.

fr.L: Et en la vingtième année de Jéroboam, roi d’Israël, Asa, roi de Juda, régna.
fr.B: La vingtième année du règne de Jéroboam, roi d’Israël, Asa devint roi de Juda.
fr.R: Asa est devenu roi de Juda pendant la vingtième année du règne de Jéroboam, roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa ishirini wa Yeroboamu mfalme wa Israeli, Asa mfalme wa Yuda akatawala.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa ishirini wa Yeroboamu mfalme wa Israeli, Asa alianza kutawala juu ya Yuda.
sw.R: Asa alianza kutawala kama mfalme wa Yuda katika mwaka wa ishirini wa utawala wa Yeroboamu mfalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Vào năm thứ hai mươi đời Giê-rô-bô-am vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, A-sa vua Giu-đa trị vì.
vi.B: Năm thứ hai mươi đời Giê-rô-bô-am vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, A-sa lên làm vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: A-sa lên làm vua Giu-đa vào năm thứ hai mươi Giê-rô-bô-am làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕 여로보암 제20년에 유다 왕 아사가 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕 여로보암이 다스린 지 20년째 되는 해에 아사가 유다의 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 아사는 여로보암이 이스라엘의 왕이 된 지 20년째 되는 해에 유다의 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E no vigésimo ano de Jeroboão, rei de Israel, Asa, rei de Judá, reinou.
pt.B: No vigésimo ano de Jeroboão, rei de Israel, Asa começou a reinar sobre Judá.
pt.R: Asa se tornou rei de Judá no vigésimo ano em que Jeroboão era rei de Israel.

am.L: በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በኢዮርብዓም በሀያኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ አሳ ነገሠ።
am.B: በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኢዮርብዓም በሀያኛው ዓመት አሳ በይሁዳ ላይ ነገሠ።
am.R: አሳ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሆነ። ይህም ኢዮርብዓም በእስራኤል ላይ በነገሠ በሀያኛው ዓመት ነበረ።

hi.L: और इस्राएल के राजा यारोबाम के बीसवें वर्ष में आसा यहूदा पर राज्य करने लगा।
hi.B: इस्राएल के राजा यारोबाम के बीसवें वर्ष में आसा यहूदा का राजा बना।
hi.R: इस्राएल के राजा यारोबाम के राज्य के बीसवें वर्ष में आसा यहूदा का राजा बना।

ru.L: И в двадцатый год Иеровоама, царя Израильского, воцарился Аса, царь Иудейский.
ru.B: В двадцатый год Иеровоама, царя Израильского, Аса воцарился над Иудой.
ru.R: Аса стал царём Иуды на двадцатом году царствования Иеровоама над Израилем.

ja.L: そしてイスラエルの王ヤロブアムの第二十年に、ユダの王アサが王となった。
ja.B: イスラエルの王ヤロブアムの治世第二十年に、アサがユダの王となった。
ja.R: イスラエルの王ヤロブアムが王になって二十年目に、アサがユダの王になりました。

uk.L: А у двадцятому році Єровоама, царя Ізраїлю, зацарював Аса, цар Юдеї.
uk.B: У двадцятому році Єровоама, царя Ізраїлю, Аса став царем Юдеї.
uk.R: Аса став царем Юдеї у двадцятий рік царювання Єровоама над Ізраїлем.

decisions.choice: reigned: became king
decisions.reason: As in verse 1, the verb with a date marks the start of the reign.

decisions.choice: became king of Judah
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "Asa king of Judah reigned"; Balanced and Readable fold the title into the verb, as the accession formula does at these levels.

decisions.choice: "царя Израильского", "царя Иудейского" in the dating formulas
decisions.reason: The history terms note words the formula with the adjective ("царя Иудейского"); the same adjective is used for the king of Israel in the formula, while running narrative says "царь Иуды", "царь Израиля".

source.text: וְאַרְבָּעִ֤ים וְאַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת־אֲבִישָׁלֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And forty and one year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem, and [the] name of his mother [was] Maacah daughter of Abishalom.

en.L: And forty-one years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother [was] Maacah daughter of Abishalom.
en.B: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Maacah daughter of Abishalom.
en.R: He ruled in Jerusalem for forty-one years. His mother was Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom.

es.L: Y cuarenta y un años reinó en Jerusalén, y el nombre de su madre [era] Maaca hija de Abisalom.
es.B: Reinó cuarenta y un años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Maaca hija de Abisalom.
es.R: Gobernó en Jerusalén durante cuarenta y un años. Su madre era Maaca, la hija de Abisalom.

fr.L: Et il régna quarante et un ans à Jérusalem, et le nom de sa mère [était] Maaka fille d’Abishalom.
fr.B: Il régna quarante et un ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Maaka, fille d’Abishalom.
fr.R: Il a régné à Jérusalem pendant quarante et un ans. Sa mère s’appelait Maaka ; c’était la fille d’Abishalom.

sw.L: Akatawala miaka arobaini na mmoja katika Yerusalemu, na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Maaka binti Abishalomu.
sw.B: Alitawala miaka arobaini na mmoja huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Maaka binti Abishalomu.
sw.R: Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka arobaini na mmoja. Mama yake aliitwa Maaka, binti Abishalomu.

vi.L: Ông trị vì bốn mươi mốt năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, và tên mẹ ông [là] Ma-a-ca con gái A-bi-sa-lôm.
vi.B: Vua trị vì bốn mươi mốt năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Ma-a-ca, con gái A-bi-sa-lôm.
vi.R: Vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem bốn mươi mốt năm. Mẹ vua là Ma-a-ca, con gái A-bi-sa-lôm.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 예루살렘에서 41년 동안 다스렸고, 그의 어머니의 이름은 아비살롬의 딸 마아가였다.
ko.B: 그는 예루살렘에서 41년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 아비살롬의 딸 마아가였다.
ko.R: 그는 예루살렘에서 41년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 아비살롬의 딸 마아가였다.

pt.L: E quarenta e um anos reinou em Jerusalém, e o nome da sua mãe [era] Maaca, filha de Absalão.
pt.B: Ele reinou quarenta e um anos em Jerusalém. A sua mãe se chamava Maaca, filha de Absalão.
pt.R: Ele governou em Jerusalém durante quarenta e um anos. A mãe dele era Maaca, filha de Absalão.

am.L: በኢየሩሳሌምም አርባ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ የእናቱም ስም የአቢሴሎም ልጅ መዓካ ነበረ።
am.B: በኢየሩሳሌም አርባ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ። የእናቱም ስም የአቢሴሎም ልጅ መዓካ ነበረ።
am.R: በኢየሩሳሌምም አርባ አንድ ዓመት ገዛ። የእናቱም ስም የአቢሴሎም ልጅ መዓካ ነበረ።

hi.L: और उसने यरूशलेम में इकतालीस वर्ष राज्य किया; उसकी माता का नाम माका था, जो अबीशालोम की पुत्री थी।
hi.B: उसने यरूशलेम में इकतालीस वर्ष राज्य किया। उसकी माता का नाम माका था, जो अबीशालोम की पुत्री थी।
hi.R: उसने यरूशलेम में इकतालीस वर्ष तक राज्य किया। उसकी माता का नाम माका था, जो अबीशालोम की बेटी थी।

ru.L: И сорок один год он царствовал в Иерусалиме; имя его матери — Мааха, дочь Авессалома.
ru.B: Сорок один год он царствовал в Иерусалиме. Имя его матери — Мааха, дочь Авессалома.
ru.R: Он правил в Иерусалиме сорок один год. Его мать звали Мааха, она была дочерью Авессалома.

ja.L: そして四十一年、彼はエルサレムで治めた。彼の母の名はアビシャロムの娘マアカであった。
ja.B: 彼はエルサレムで四十一年間治めた。母の名はマアカといい、アビシャロムの娘であった。
ja.R: アサはエルサレムで四十一年間治めました。母はアビシャロムの娘マアカでした。

uk.L: І сорок один рік він царював у Єрусалимі; а імʼя його матері — Мааха, дочка Авішалома.
uk.B: Він царював у Єрусалимі сорок один рік. Імʼя його матері — Мааха, дочка Авішалома.
uk.R: Він правив у Єрусалимі сорок один рік. Його мати була Мааха, дочка Авішалома.

decisions.choice: his mother: probably his grandmother, who stayed queen mother
decisions.reason: Verse 2 gives the same name, Maacah daughter of Abishalom, for the mother of Abijam, Asa's father. "Mother" here most likely means grandmother: Maacah kept her place as queen mother into Asa's reign until he removed her (verse 13). Another possibility is that Asa was Abijam's brother rather than his son, but verse 8 calls him Abijam's son. Every level keeps "mother", as the text has it.

decisions.choice: He reigned forty-one years; He ruled ... for forty-one years
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: mama yake
decisions.reason: Swahili keeps "mama yake" (his mother) as the Hebrew and the English do; the meaning decision explains that Maacah was probably his grandmother who stayed queen mother.

decisions.choice: "mẹ" kept for Maacah
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "his mother"; the meaning decision explains that she was probably his grandmother who stayed queen mother. Vietnamese must name the kin exactly, so the Hebrew's word is kept and the note carries the explanation.

decisions.choice: "उसकी माता" at every level
decisions.reason: Maacah was probably his grandmother, who stayed queen mother (meaning m1); Hindi keeps "माता" as the Hebrew and the English do.

decisions.choice: "имя его матери"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "his mother", probably meaning his grandmother, who stayed queen mother (m1); every level keeps "мать", as the English does, and the age-and-mother formula stays the same.

decisions.choice: immo "母" at every level, as 15:2
decisions.reason: Probably his grandmother, who stayed queen mother; the text says mother, and the meaning decision explains it.

source.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אָסָ֛א הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּדָוִ֖ד אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And did Asa the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh, like David his father.

en.L: And Asa did the right in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, like David his father.
en.B: Asa did what was right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as his ancestor David had done.
en.R: Asa did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was right, as his ancestor David had done.

es.L: E hizo Asá lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como David su padre.
es.B: Asá hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como lo había hecho su antepasado David.
es.R: Asá hizo lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, como lo había hecho su antepasado David.

fr.L: Et Asa fit ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme David son père.
fr.B: Asa fit ce qui est juste aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme l’avait fait David son ancêtre.
fr.R: Asa a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare bon, comme son ancêtre David.

sw.L: Asa akafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama Daudi baba yake.
sw.B: Asa alifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama babu yake Daudi alivyofanya.
sw.R: Asa alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mema, kama babu yake Daudi alivyofanya.

vi.L: A-sa làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như Đa-vít tổ phụ ông.
vi.B: A-sa làm điều ngay thẳng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như Đa-vít tổ tiên vua đã làm.
vi.R: A-sa làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là phải, như Đa-vít tổ tiên vua đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 아사가 그의 아버지 다윗처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 올바른 일을 했다.
ko.B: 아사는 그의 조상 다윗처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 올바른 일을 했다.
ko.R: 아사는 그의 조상 다윗처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했다.

pt.L: E Asa fez o reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como Davi, seu pai.
pt.B: Asa fez o que era reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como o seu antepassado Davi tinha feito.
pt.R: Asa fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava certo, como o seu antepassado Davi tinha feito.

am.L: አሳም እንደ አባቱ እንደ ዳዊት {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ዓይን ቅን የሆነውን አደረገ።
am.B: አሳ እንደ ቅድመ አያቱ እንደ ዳዊት {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ቅን የሆነውን አደረገ።
am.R: አሳ እንደ ቅድመ አያቱ እንደ ዳዊት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ትክክል ነው የሚለውን አደረገ።

hi.L: और आसा ने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में ठीक था, जैसा उसके पिता दाऊद ने [किया था]।
hi.B: आसा ने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में ठीक था, जैसा उसके पूर्वज दाऊद ने किया था।
hi.R: आसा ने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में ठीक था, जैसा उसके पूर्वज दाऊद ने किया था।

ru.L: И Аса делал то, что было правильным в глазах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, как Давид, его отец.
ru.B: Аса делал то, что было правильным в глазах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, как его предок Давид.
ru.R: Аса делал то, что нравилось {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, как его предок Давид.

ja.L: そしてアサは、父ダビデのように、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の目に正しいことを行った。
ja.B: アサは、先祖ダビデと同じように、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の目に正しいとされることを行った。
ja.R: アサは、先祖ダビデと同じように、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が正しいと言われることをしました。

uk.L: І робив Аса правильне в очах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, як Давид, його батько.
uk.B: Аса робив те, що було правильне в очах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, як робив його предок Давид.
uk.R: Аса робив те, що подобалося {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, як робив його предок Давид.

decisions.choice: did what was right in Yahweh's eyes: the good verdict
decisions.reason: Asa is the first king after Solomon to receive the good verdict, and he is compared to David (verse 5). Verses 12-15 say what he did, and verse 14 adds the one thing he did not do.

decisions.choice: did the right in [the] eyes of / did what was right in the sight of / did what the LORD said was right
decisions.reason: The good verdict is worded like the evil one (14:22), at each level the same way throughout the book. "Ancestor" as in verse 3.

decisions.choice: "उसने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में ठीक था"
decisions.reason: The good verdict of the history-books note, word for word at every level, where the English Readable says "what the LORD said was right".

decisions.choice: "делал то, что было правильным в глазах ГОСПОДА" (L, B); "делал то, что нравилось ГОСПОДУ" (R)
decisions.reason: The good verdict formula of the history terms note, word for word.

source.text: וַיַּעֲבֵ֥ר הַקְּדֵשִׁ֖ים מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּ֨סַר֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַגִּלֻּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made pass away the male shrine prostitutes from the land, and he removed all the idols which had made his fathers.

en.L: And he made the male cult prostitutes pass away from the land, and he removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
en.B: He drove the male shrine prostitutes out of the land and removed all the idols his ancestors had made.
en.R: He drove out of the land the men who served as prostitutes at the shrines. He got rid of all the idols his ancestors had made.

es.L: E hizo desaparecer de la tierra a los prostitutos de culto, y quitó todos los ídolos que habían hecho sus padres.
es.B: Expulsó de la tierra a los prostitutos de los santuarios y quitó todos los ídolos que habían hecho sus antepasados.
es.R: Expulsó del país a los hombres que servían como prostitutos en los santuarios. Se deshizo de todos los ídolos que habían hecho sus antepasados.

fr.L: Et il fit disparaître du pays les prostitués sacrés, et il ôta toutes les idoles que ses pères avaient faites.
fr.B: Il chassa du pays les hommes qui se prostituaient dans les sanctuaires et fit disparaître toutes les idoles que ses ancêtres avaient faites.
fr.R: Il a chassé du pays les hommes qui servaient de prostitués dans les sanctuaires. Il s’est débarrassé de toutes les idoles que ses ancêtres avaient faites.

sw.L: Akawaondoa makahaba wa kiume wa ibada kutoka nchini, akaziondoa sanamu zote ambazo baba zake walizifanya.
sw.B: Akawafukuza nchini makahaba wa kiume wa mahali pa ibada, akaziondoa sanamu zote za miungu ambazo babu zake walikuwa wamezitengeneza.
sw.R: Aliwafukuza nchini wanaume waliofanya ukahaba katika mahali pa ibada. Akaziondoa sanamu zote ambazo babu zake walikuwa wamezitengeneza.

vi.L: Ông khiến các nam kỹ nơi miếu thờ biến khỏi xứ, và dẹp bỏ mọi thần tượng mà tổ phụ ông đã làm.
vi.B: Vua đuổi các nam kỹ nơi miếu thờ ra khỏi xứ và dẹp bỏ mọi thần tượng mà các vua trước đã làm.
vi.R: Vua đuổi ra khỏi xứ những người đàn ông làm nghề mại dâm tại các nơi thờ thần. Vua dẹp bỏ mọi thần tượng mà tổ tiên vua đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 신전 남창들을 그 땅에서 사라지게 하고, 그의 조상들이 만든 모든 우상을 없앴다.
ko.B: 그는 신전 남창들을 그 땅에서 쫓아내고, 그의 조상들이 만든 우상들을 모두 없앴다.
ko.R: 그는 신전에서 몸을 파는 남자들을 그 땅에서 쫓아냈다. 그리고 그의 조상들이 만든 우상들을 모두 없앴다.

pt.L: E ele fez passar da terra os prostitutos cultuais, e removeu todos os ídolos que os seus pais tinham feito.
pt.B: Ele expulsou da terra os prostitutos de santuário e removeu todos os ídolos que os seus antepassados tinham feito.
pt.R: Ele expulsou da terra os homens que se prostituíam nos santuários. Acabou com todos os ídolos que os seus antepassados tinham feito.

am.L: የቤተ ጣዖት ወንድ ዝሙት አዳሪዎችንም ከምድሪቱ አሳለፈ፤ አባቶቹ የሠሯቸውንም ጣዖታት ሁሉ አስወገደ።
am.B: የቤተ ጣዖት ወንድ ዝሙት አዳሪዎችን ከምድሪቱ አባረረ፤ አባቶቹ የሠሯቸውንም ጣዖታት ሁሉ አስወገደ።
am.R: በጣዖት ማምለኪያ ስፍራዎች በዝሙት አዳሪነት የሚሠሩትን ወንዶች ከምድሪቱ አባረረ። አባቶቹ የሠሯቸውንም ጣዖታት ሁሉ አጠፋ።

hi.L: और उसने देवदासों को देश में से दूर किया, और उन सब मूरतों को हटा दिया जो उसके पूर्वजों ने बनाई थीं।
hi.B: उसने पूजा-स्थलों के पुरुष वेश्याओं को देश से निकाल दिया और उन सब मूरतों को हटा दिया जो उसके पूर्वजों ने बनाई थीं।
hi.R: उसने उन पुरुषों को देश से निकाल दिया जो पूजा-स्थलों पर वेश्या का काम करते थे। उसने उन सब मूर्तियों को भी हटा दिया जो उसके पूर्वजों ने बनाई थीं।

ru.L: И изгнал он храмовых блудников из земли, и удалил всех истуканов, которых сделали его отцы.
ru.B: Он изгнал из страны храмовых блудников и убрал всех истуканов, которых сделали его предки.
ru.R: Он выгнал из страны мужчин, которые занимались блудом при святилищах. Он убрал всех идолов, которых сделали его предки.

ja.L: そして彼は神殿男娼たちをその地から去らせ、彼の先祖たちが造ったすべての偶像を取り除いた。
ja.B: 彼は神殿男娼たちを国から追い出し、先祖が造ったすべての偶像を取り除いた。
ja.R: アサは、礼拝所で体を売る男たちを国から追い出しました。そして、先祖たちが作った偶像を、すべて取り除きました。

uk.L: І вигнав він храмових розпусників з краю, і усунув усіх бовванів, яких наробили його батьки.
uk.B: Він вигнав з краю храмових розпусників і усунув усіх бовванів, яких наробили його предки.
uk.R: Він вигнав з краю чоловіків, які віддавалися розпусті при святилищах. Він позбувся всіх ідолів, яких наробили його предки.

decisions.choice: male shrine prostitutes: men who served at the shrines of other gods
decisions.reason: The men attached to the shrines whom Rehoboam's Judah had allowed, as at 14:24, where the note explains the word and why its sexual sense is not certain.

decisions.choice: idols: a scornful word for idols
decisions.reason: The word is used only for idols, and always with contempt; it may come from a word for dung (Ezekiel uses it often). It names images of other gods that earlier kings had allowed.

decisions.choice: his fathers: the kings before him
decisions.reason: Rehoboam and Abijam, and before them Solomon, who built shrines for foreign gods (11:7-8).

decisions.choice: the men who served as prostitutes at the shrines
decisions.reason: Each level words the term as at 14:24; Readable explains it with a short description.

decisions.choice: sanamu (Literal, Readable); sanamu za miungu (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is a scornful one for idols; Swahili "sanamu" is the plain word, and the scorn is left to the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: os ídolos
decisions.reason: The scornful word for idols (m2) is "ídolos" at every level, as the English; Portuguese has no common word that carries the contempt of the Hebrew without sounding forced, and the meaning note gives it.

decisions.choice: "ጣዖታት" for the gillulim
decisions.reason: As the Amharic Leviticus 26:30; the Hebrew word is scornful, and "ጣዖት" is the plain Amharic word for an idol, already a word of contempt.
A scornful word for idols (meaning m2), as Leviticus 26:30 in this translation; the shrine prostitutes as 14:24.

decisions.choice: "истуканы" (L, B); "идолы" (R)
decisions.reason: A scornful word for idols (m2); "истукан" keeps the scorn, and Readable says the plain word.

decisions.choice: gillulim "偶像" at every level
decisions.reason: A scornful word for idols; Japanese has no neutral-versus-scornful pair as English idols does, so the plain word is kept, as DEU 29:16.

source.text: וְגַ֣ם׀אֶת־מַעֲכָ֣ה אִמּ֗וֹ וַיְסִרֶ֨הָ֙ מִגְּבִירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָ֥ה מִפְלֶ֖צֶת לָאֲשֵׁרָ֑ה וַיִּכְרֹ֤ת אָסָא֙ אֶת־מִפְלַצְתָּ֔הּ וַיִּשְׂרֹ֖ף בְּנַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And also Maacah his mother, and he removed her from [being] queen mother, because she had made a horrid thing for Asherah; and cut down Asa her horrid thing and burned [it] in [the] valley of Kidron.

en.L: And also Maacah his mother: he removed her from [being] queen mother, because she had made a horrid thing for Asherah; and Asa cut down her horrid thing and burned [it] in the valley of Kidron.
en.B: He even deposed his mother Maacah as queen mother, because she had made a horrid image for Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
en.R: He even took away the title of queen mother from Maacah, his mother, because she had made a disgusting idol to worship the goddess Asherah. Asa cut the idol down and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

es.L: Y también a Maaca su madre la quitó de [ser] reina madre, porque había hecho una cosa horrible para Aserá; y Asá cortó su cosa horrible y [la] quemó en el valle del Cedrón.
es.B: Incluso destituyó a su madre Maaca como reina madre, porque había hecho una imagen horrible para Aserá. Asá cortó la imagen y la quemó en el valle del Cedrón.
es.R: Hasta le quitó el título de reina madre a Maaca, su madre, porque había hecho un ídolo repugnante para adorar a la diosa Aserá. Asá derribó el ídolo y lo quemó en el valle del Cedrón.

fr.L: Et même Maaka sa mère, il l’écarta de [la dignité de] reine mère, parce qu’elle avait fait une horreur pour Ashéra ; et Asa abattit son horreur et [la] brûla dans la vallée du Cédron.
fr.B: Il destitua même sa mère Maaka de sa dignité de reine mère, parce qu’elle avait fait une image horrible pour Ashéra. Asa abattit cette image et la brûla dans la vallée du Cédron.
fr.R: Il a même enlevé à Maaka, sa mère, son titre de reine mère, parce qu’elle avait fait une idole répugnante pour adorer la déesse Ashéra. Asa a abattu cette idole et il l’a brûlée dans la vallée du Cédron.
